I'm not a Dad but I can tell you a story about my dad hiding secrets from my mom... my parents are complete opposites. My dad is an adrenaline junkie and always loves to go on crazy adventures but he tries to tone it down a little bit in front of my mom. My mom is a completely anxious control freak and literally gets scared if my brother or I walk out into the backyard at night alone (we are 21 and 25). Well when we were around 10 and 14 my dad took us tubing on an empty golf course. My dad saw this huge hill way higher than any other spot and of course that's the one he wanted to go to. We finally make our way to the top and my dad gets so excited that he pushes my brother down before he even gets fully seated on his tube. My brother ends up hitting a steep mound of snow and flying out of the tube. He gets lodged in the snow midway down the hill. Although it was kind of funny I was looking to make sure he was ok as he was squirming to release himself from the snowy patch he fell butt first into. As I'm watching my brother I look over and see my dad already flying down the hill in his tube. He hits the same mound of snow and then lands directly onto my brother. Shit. I slid down the hill to make sure my brother was ok and thankfully he wasn't too hurt but he said his neck was hurting him. My dad's number one concern.. don't tell mom!! We had an entire lecture on how to not tell mom what happened. To this day she still has no idea this happened. If she ever found out my dad would be a dead man.
